touched…|Cal Kestis, overlooking Kashyyyk|}} '''Kashyyyk''', also known as '''Planet Wookiee C''' to some [[human]]s in the [[Core Worlds]], was a [[wroshyr tree]]-covered [[forest]] [[planet]] located in the southwestern quadrant of [[the galaxy]] and the homeworld of the [[Wookiee]] [[species]]. Four [[Millennium|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Kashyyyk was discovered by the [[Czerka Arms|Czerka Corporation]], who [[Slavery|enslaved]] the Wookiee population and renamed the planet '''G5-623''', later to '''Edean'''. Using superior technology, the company managed to enslave the Wookiees until an [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk|uprising]] drove the oppressors away. During the [[Clone Wars]], Kashyyyk was a member of the [[Galactic Republic]], and endured [[Occupation of Kashyyyk|enslavement]] under the [[Galactic Empire]], the Republic's successor. Later, during the rise of the [[New Republic]], Kashyyyk was liberated with the help of Republic forces led by [[Han Solo]]. ==Description== {{Quote|Hunting on Kashyyyk is a great challenge. If you don't get eaten by one of the fierce creatures on the planet, you just might by one of the plantsss.|[[Charr]]|''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''}} [[File:Can-cell_kashyyyk.png|thumb|left|250px|Can-cells fly over Kashyyyk's mountains.]] Kashyyyk was a temperate [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[orbit]]ing around a single [[star]] located in the [[Mytaranor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. The planet had a complement of three [[moon]]s, one of which was [[Color|orange]].''[[Last Shot]]'' The planet had no axial tilt and a perfectly circular orbit, causing it to lack seasons. The center of the planet was covered with a tropical ocean belt, which contained a number of islands and large [[coral]] reefs. Covered in [[wroshyr tree]]s, Kashyyyk served as [[homeworld]] to the [[Wookiee]] [[species]]. Native fauna, such as [[Can-cell]]s would influence the design of [[starship]]s by the Wookiee inhabitants, while great [[City|cities]], such as [[Kachirho]] would be built into the planet's [[tree]]s. The Kashyyykian wilds could be dangerous to many, thanks to dangerous animals, such as [[Terentatek]]s or [[wyyyschokk]] [[spider]]s in addition to [[carnivorous plant]]s, such as the [[jaw plant]] and [[saava]]. The crash site of the prison ship ''[[Ashmead's Lock]]'' was known as the [[Black Forest]]. Wookiees believed that the Black Forest was cursed and haunted by bad spirits. By [[5 ABY]], sections of Kashyyyk's forests had been deforested and several rivers had been drained. The Empire also established undersea mining platforms. [[Mount Arayakyak]] was once a rainforest orchard known as the Cultivating Talon, which provided Wookiees with fruits, such as [[shi-shok]]. By the [[Imperial Era]], it had been defoliated by a poisonous black mold. [[7 ABY|Two years]] after the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|planet's]] liberation by the New Republic, much of the Black Forest had grown back. The growing forest was still littered with the remnants of Imperial machinery, including an [[All Terrain Armored Cargo Transport|AT-ACT walker]]. Kashyyyk was in the same star system as [[Trandosha]], the home of the [[Trandoshan]] species, who were traditional enemies of the Wookiees. ==History== ===The Zeffo and Czerka occupation=== In its early history, the Zeffo, an ancient technologically advanced species, travelled to Kashyyyk where they had contact with the Wookiees. [[Millennium|Millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Predori]] [[prison]] [[Starship|ship]] ''[[Ashmead's Lock]]'' crashed on the planet when a nearby [[gravity well]] collapsed on itself. Four [[Millennium|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Kashyyyk was discovered by the [[Czerka Arms|Czerka Corporation]], who renamed the planet G5-623, and later to Edean. Using superior technology, the company managed to [[Slavery|enslave]] the Wookiees until an [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk|uprising]] drove the invaders away. That painful episode left lasting scars in the Wookiees' hearts. ===Republic Era=== {{Quote|What about the droid attack on the Wookiees?|Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|}} [[File:LifeDay-RaxloStrikesBack-YJA-Thumbnails.png|thumb|left|Life Day during the High Republic era.]] By [[232 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order]] had established a [[Kashyyyk Jedi outpost|Jedi outpost]] on Kashyyyk.''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' As well as celebrating life day At some point prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] faced a [[terentatek]] on Kashyyyk, accompanied by his then [[Padawan]] [[Dooku]]. At another point, Jedi Master [[Eno Cordova]] was researching [[Zeffonian]] culture on Kashyyyk, and befriended Wookiee [[chief]]tain [[Tarfful]]. For twenty [[Standard year|years]], Kashyyyk's Wookiees, as well as the Wookiee population of its colony planets, needed to repeatedly repel the [[Trade Federation]].[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|It is settled then. Yoda will take a battalion of clones to reinforce the Wookiees on Kashyyyk.|[[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]]|}} [[File:WookieeRoar.png|thumb|left|250px|Aided by the clone forces of the Galactic Republic, the Wookiees defended their homeworld from a Separatist invasion.]] In the years following the Invasion of [[Naboo]], the rogue Jedi [[Count]] Dooku fomented [[Politics|political]] turmoil on the planet.[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] Due to its status as a major navigational point, Kashyyyk was of prime strategic importance to the [[Galactic Republic]]. After the Wookiees [[Defense of Kashyyyk|fought off its raiders]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk|attacked]] the planet toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. During the battle for their homeworld, hundreds of the Wookiee's [[Oevvaor jet catamaran|catamarans]] were deployed. Eventually, the Confederacy's invasion [[fleet]] was driven off by [[Jedi General]] [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Yoda]]'s [[Yoda's Republic taskforce|taskforce]], but a massive force of [[LM-432 crab droid]]s, [[droid tank]]s, and [[gunship]]s remained and occupied the [[Wawaatt Archipelago]]. In the last days of the [[Clone Wars]], with the help of Yoda and Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] managed to get the upper hand over the Separatists. However, shortly after that victory, the [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] unilaterally [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] the government into the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]]. While Yoda was able to escape from the [[clone trooper]]s that attacked him after the initiation of [[Order 66]], Unduli was captured and taken to [[Stygeon Prime]]'s prison, [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|the Spire]].{{Rebels|Rise of the Old Masters}} ===Imperial repression=== {{Quote|He's a Wookiee, right? Kashyyyk, that's where he comes from, that's his home. But it's not his anymore. I've been there. I've seen what the Empire has done. They ripped down the trees. They put cuffs and collars on all the Wookiees. Some of them they cut open. Others they ship off to work the worst jobs the Empire has on offer.|Han Solo|}}
[[File:Mylaya-CGSWG.png|thumb|250px|Certain tribes of Wookiees rode mylaya as mounts.]]
Despite Kashyyyk's loyalty to the Republic, the self-appointed [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] had the Wookiees [[Occupation of Kashyyyk|enslaved]], and their planet itself was [[blockade]]d, when the Empire launched a [[Pacification of Kashyyyk|siege]] of the planet.[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] Used as [[Slavery|slave]] labor, the Empire would utilize the Wookiees to cut down the planet's native wroshyr trees for lumber and farm [[Foodstuff|food]] to feed the [[Imperial Army]] as well as send them off to labor camps and construction jobs, such as building the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], or for science and bio-weapon experiments.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] In addition to being [[Occupation of Kashyyyk|occupied]] and enslaved, Kashyyyk was also stripped of its name and designated [[Imperial territory G5-623]]. Several months into Kashyyyk's occupation, [[Trandoshan]] mercenaries were contracted by the Empire and supplied with [[Incinerator tank]]s. Under the supervision of clone stormtroopers, the Trandoshans were tasked with burning down large sectors of forest on the planet in an effort to make way for Imperial industrialization. Order 66 survivor [[Padawan]] [[Gungi]] later assisted a tribe of Wookiees in [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Force 99)|destroying]] a convoy of these tanks.{{TBB|Tribe}} By [[18 BBY]], news of the Imperial subjugation of Kashyyyk had spread to the news bulletins, leading the former [[Jedi]] Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano]] to worry about her Wookiee friend [[Chewbacca]], who she had briefly met during the Clone Wars. [[File:CalMeetsTarfful.png|thumb|left|250px|Padawan Cal Kestis worked with a resistance cell on Kashyyyk during his quest to restore the Jedi Order.]] In [[14 BBY]], a [[Partisans|rebel cell]] led by [[Saw Gerrera]] was present on Kashyyyk and in [[Liberation on Kashyyyk|conflict]] with the Empire. During this fight, Order 66 survivor [[Cal Kestis]] and the [[Stinger Mantis crew|crew]] of the ''[[Stinger Mantis]]'' arrived to continue their search for a [[Jedi holocron]]. Gerrera's cell assisted them in their search for Tarfful, but the majority of their forces later retreated after being overwhelmed by the Empire. Cal crossed paths with Kashyyyk again when he received a communication that Tarfful was willing to meet. Back on Kashyyyk, Tarfful instructed Cal to seek answers at the top of the Origin Tree. On the way up, he was attacked by the [[Ninth Sister]], whose ship was taken down by a large winged creature. Cal found the creature wounded from the attack and healed it, granting him access to the top of the Origin tree via a flight on its back. Cal is attacked once again by the Ninth Sister and defeated her. At some point during the [[Imperial Era]], the natives of Kashyyyk attempted to [[Wookiee revolt|revolt]] against the Empire. However, [[General]] [[Kahdah]] and the Imperial [[212th Attack Battalion]] managed to quell the insurrection. On Kashyyyk, the [[Spectres]] raided several supply convoys before the [[Battle of Yavin]].{{SW|url=games-apps/star-wars-rebels-ghost-raid|text=''Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid''|int=Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid|nolive=1}} In the years leading up to the Battle of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]], the Imperial [[Commodore]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]] discovered that Wookiee slaves from Kashyyyk were being transported for processing and health checks to [[Lansend Twenty-Six]]. They also foiled an [[Battle at Lansend Twenty-Six|attempt]] by the insurgent leader [[Nevil Cygni|Nightswan]] to rescue the slaves.[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] [[File:Kashyyyk_Defender_XWM.png|thumb|right|213px|A Wookiee [[Auzituck anti-slaver gunship]] patrols against slavers.]] Regardless of the Empire's grip on the planet, Kashyyyk became an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[safe world]]. A map of [[the galaxy]] with a legend listing the various Alliance safe worlds, [[starfighter]] hubs at level five or higher, rebel operations sectors and regional headquarters, and shadow planets with deep space caches, included Kashyyyk. The map would eventually be included in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''. Some time before the [[Battle of Endor]] occurred, a [[Massacre on Kashyyyk|massacre]] occurred on the planet under the command of the Empire.''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' ===Galactic Civil War=== In the [[Standard month|months]] following the Battle of [[Endor]] and the [[death]] of the Galactic Empire's totalitarian ruler, the [[New Order]] would be thrown into a fractured and volatile state, putting Kashyyyk on lockdown as supply lines and convoys fell victim to the newly formed [[New Republic]]. Imperial territory G5-623 was ruled by [[Grand Moff]] [[Lozen Tolruck]], who enslaved the Wookiee population using [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]]. Like [[Governor]] [[Ubrik Adelhard]]'s [[Ubrik Adelhard's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]], Tolruck propagated the myth that Palpatine was alive and well. He did not fall in line with the Imperial forces commanded by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]] and [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Gallius Rax]]. [[File:LiberationOfKashyyyk-TheForceAwakens2.png|thumb|left|213px|As the Galactic Empire declined, Han Solo endeavored to liberate the homeworld of his friend, the Wookiee Chewbacca.]] With the Republic unwilling to divert resources towards the planet, [[Han Solo]] and Chewbacca would undertake a mission on the world with various other Wookiee [[refugee]]s turned [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] after intelligence from [[Imra]] reported that Imperial redeployments would reduce the planet's garrison, if only for a few [[Standard day|days]]. Imra's information proved unreliable and Chewbacca was captured by the Empire and imprisoned at Ashmead's Lock. Han managed to rescue Chewie and the other prisoners with the help of [[Norra Wexley]] and [[Norra Wexley's team|her rebel band]]. While Norra and her son, [[Temmin Wexley]] returned to [[Chandrila]] with the other prisoners, Han and Chewie along with the former Imperial loyalty officer [[Sinjir Rath Velus]] and the New Republic soldier [[Jom Barell]] led a successful Wookiee [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|slave rebellion]] against Tolruck's Imperial remnant. Sinjir managed to neutralize Tolruck's chips with a hyperspace transceiver. With his forces overwhelmed, Tolruck ordered his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]] to bombard Kashyyyk. However, a New Republic fleet led by [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar|Ackbar]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] attacked the Imperial fleet and forced their surrender. ===New Republic Era=== Following the liberation of Kashyyyk, Wookiee and New Republic forces conducted mopping-up operations against Imperial holdouts. During one of these operations, Chewbacca reunited with his son, [[Lumpawaroo]], who had escaped from an Imperial slave labor camp. By [[7 ABY]], Chewbacca had settled down in a village led by the female Wookiee chief [[Karasshki]]. Around that time, the rogue [[Pau'an]] surgeon [[Fyzen Gor]] began kidnapping and killing Wookiees, harvesting their limbs for his [[Original Dozen]] droid followers. Gor earned the nickname "Long Man." When Han Solo and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] visited Kashyyyk, seeking Chewbacca's help in a quest to recover the [[Phylanx Redux Transmitter]]. Chewbacca agreed to help Han and Lando track down this "Long Man" in order to recover the remains of the murdered Wookiees to give them proper funeral rites. Chewbacca subsequently returned to Kashyyyk following his adventures. The following years of relative peace allowed the forests of Kashyyyk to heal and regrow. Chewbacca lived on Kashyyyk with his [[Chewbacca's family|family]] until resuming his adventures with Han Solo prior to the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. ===Target of the First Order=== [[File:First-Order-Encampment.png|thumb|right|250px|The First Order targeted Kashyyyk during its conquest of the galaxy.]] During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], the First Order launched a [[Blockade of Kashyyyk|blockade]] of the planet and deployed an element of its [[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] to the surface. When the Resistance arrived to end the [[blockade]], the First Order attempted to enslave members of the Wookiee population, but the operation was stopped by Chewbacca.{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=29|story=Ghosts of Kashyyyk, Part 3}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:House_exterior_rmq.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tree-house concept art by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] used in ''The Star Wars Holiday Special'']] Kashyyyk, the homeworld of the Wookiee species appeared as "Kasshook" or "Kazzook (Ganaararlacc)" in [[George Lucas]]'s notes for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and was set to appear in the film, described as a planet with huge trees.''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]'' According to {{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-wookiees|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Wookiees}}, the original drafts of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] called for the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] to be built in [[orbit]] around Kashyyyk by Wookiee slave labor and it was not until later drafts that Lucas decided that the setting and characters would be changed to the forest moon of [[Endor]] and [[Ewok]]s,{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-wookiees|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Wookiees}} but ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' and ''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' contradict this, instead saying that Ewoks and Endor were present in Lucas's earliest notes and scripts for ''Return of the Jedi'' while Kashyyyk and Wookiees other than Chewbacca were never present.''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' The [[Kashyyyk/Legends|planet]] first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[1978]] in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' Kashyyyk's first canon appearance was in [[2005]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Kashyyyk appeared in the non-[[canon]] animated television series ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' episode "[[Peril on Kashyyyk]],"{{FreemakerAdventures|Peril on Kashyyyk}} which premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[June 27]], [[2016]].{{DisneyPress|abc=1|url=disneyxd/shows/lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures/episodes/peril-on-kashyyyk|text=Peril}} As in the Legends and Canon timelines, Kashyyyk is blockaded by an Imperial fleet. In the story, the [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]], a scavenging family, rescue the Wookiee prince [[Tantarra]] from a [[Trandoshan]] fortress island. Hitherto, the Trandoshans had been ruling Kashyyyk on the Empire's behalf and had taken Tantarra as a hostage in order to force Tantarra's submission.
